answer: Most convincing: on-ledger slashing of verifiers who countersign invalid transactions. Each verifier posts bonded stake; an epoch committee's pulse of signatures attests every block. If a block is proven invalid, the chain burns every signer's stake, sized several times above a full epoch reward. Fake identities are cheap, but influence needs staked capital that can be vaporized, so a meadow of sybils gains nothing. Attacker cost: deep collateral per identity plus expected loss exceeding any gain from a coordinated ripple of false attestations.
